    org.apache.accumulo.core.client.admin.compaction.CompactionConfigurer.InputParameters.getSelectedFiles()
    4.0.0
    For user and selector compactions: Returns the selected set of files to be compacted. When getInputFiles() (inputFiles) and getSelectedFiles() (selectedFiles) are equal, then this is the final compaction. When they are not equal, this is an intermediate compaction. Intermediate compactions are compactions whose resultant RFile will be consumed by another compaction. inputFiles and selectedFiles can be compared using: selectedFiles.equals(inputFiles instanceof Set ?
